name: After § 9
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 9a. Recalls the EU’s continued support for popular protests against the mullah regime in Tehran; recalls that this regime has been violently repressing its own population for decades, as illustrated in particular by the killing of Mahsa Amini on 16 September 2022 by the Iranian morality police; deplores the fact that, according to several non-governmental organisations, more than 500 people have been killed by the Iranian regime since the protests began in 2026;
